entities.name: Udrra ben Abd Allah al-Fihrí
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Udhra ibn Abd Allah al-Fihri was a fleeting Umayyad governor of Al Andalus in 726. He may have been chosen by Anbasa to succeed him as governor, but his term lasted no more than six months until he completed the task of withdrawing the troops Anbasa had commanded during his last campaign in Gaul.

entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Udhra ibn Abd Allah al-Fihri was a fleeting Umayyad governor of Al Andalus in 726. He may have been chosen by Anbasa to succeed him as governor, but his term lasted no more than six months until he completed the task of withdrawing the troops Anbasa had commanded during his last campaign in Gaul.
